loading_note: This repo does NOT load via transformers.AutoModel.from_pretrained — the `transformers` library has no MLX backend. Use `trellis2_mlx.pipeline.Trellis2ImageTo3DPipelineMLX.from_pretrained(ckpt_dir=..., pipeline_json=...)` from the `trellis2-mlx` package.
dit_compute_dtype_note: Pass `dit_compute_dtype='float16'` to `from_pretrained` (or `--dit-dtype float16` to run_example.py) to cast DiT weights to fp16 at load time for ~25-32% speedup on Apple Silicon. Verified essentially-lossless on T.png 512: median vertex displacement 1e-6 (sub-pixel). Defaults to bfloat16 for strict parity with upstream.
tensor_name_convention: Each component's tensors are prefixed with a component tag (`ss_flow.`, `shape_dec.`, `tex_flow_512.`, …) so all 4418 tensors across the 10 shards live in a single unified namespace. The pipeline's weight-loader strips the prefix at load time. Per-file `*.bijection.json` records the torch↔MLX mapping against the un-prefixed names.
total_params_4b: SS flow (1.3B) + Shape flow (1.3B) + Tex flow (1.3B) + VAE/decoder heads (~0.5B) ≈ 4B

sparse_structure_flow_model.role: Stage 1: flow-matching DiT predicting 16^3 occupancy latents conditioned on image features

sparse_structure_decoder.role: Dense 3D conv upsampler: 16^3 × 8 latent → 64^3 binary occupancy

shape_slat_flow_model_512.role: Stage 2: sparse flow-matching DiT predicting shape SLat per active voxel (32-dim) at 512^3

shape_slat_flow_model_1024.role: Stage 2 (1024 variant): sparse DiT at 1024^3 resolution for cascade pipelines

shape_slat_decoder.role: Sparse UNet VAE decoder: 5-stage, 16× spatial upsample, per-voxel (xyz, intersections, quad_lerp)

shape_slat_encoder.role: Training-only: shape VAE encoder (shipped for reference, not used at inference)

tex_slat_flow_model_512.role: Stage 3: sparse DiT predicting PBR texture SLat (concat-conditioned on shape latent)
tex_slat_flow_model_512.deferred_note: Texture pipeline deferred to v2; weights converted and included for completeness

tex_slat_decoder.role: Sparse UNet VAE decoder for PBR (6 channels: RGB base_color + metallic + roughness + alpha)

image_cond_model.name: DinoV3FeatureExtractor
image_cond_model.note: Runs in torch; ~300M params; feeds (1, N, 1024) patch features to every DiT via cross-attention. HF-gated, requires access.

rembg_model.name: BiRefNet
rembg_model.backend: torch (auto-picks MPS when available, else CPU; --rembg-device cpu|mps to override)
rembg_model.note: Lazy-loaded only when the input image lacks a meaningful alpha channel; weights are aggressively gc'd before DiT inference to avoid memory contention. Requires the `rembg` extras (`uv sync --extra rembg`).

notes: DiT weights: bf16 → bf16 (identity dtype, names remapped e.g. mlp.0 → mlp.layers.0 for MLX Sequential).
Sparse conv weights are stored as (Co, Kd, Kh, Kw, Ci) already in upstream (per conv_flex_gemm.py:34); preserved.
Dense conv3d weights (SS decoder) permuted from torch (Co, Ci, Kd, Kh, Kw) to MLX NDHWC (Co, Kd, Kh, Kw, Ci).

After conversion, `prefix_checkpoints.py` re-saves every shard with its tensors prefixed by a component tag so a single unified `model.safetensors.index.json` can address all 4418 tensors without name collisions (tensor names like `blocks.0.self_attn.to_qkv.weight` repeat across the 3 DiTs).
